title: 401 intermitente 'token used before issued' porque uma mudança de firewall bloqueou NTP e um nó derivou o relógio
what_it_tests: Juntar três pistas fracas: erro só em um host, aviso de NTP nesse host, e um deploy de infra que não parece relacionado a autenticação.

ticket.subject: Intermittent 401 'token used before issued' on roughly 1 in 4 API calls
ticket.description: Several customers get sporadic HTTP 401 with 'token used before issued'. Retrying usually works. Started yesterday afternoon. API service: acme/api, infrastructure changes go through acme/platform-infra.

comments.author: Marcus (Platform Team)
comments.body: The API runs on 4 nodes behind the load balancer.

related_tickets.subject: Customers getting 401 after their access tokens expired
related_tickets.resolution: Client was not refreshing tokens. Documented the refresh flow.

deploys.message: security: restrict egress on api node pool to tcp/443 only
deploys.author: Lena

deploys.message: chore: bump api node pool base image to 2026.09
deploys.author: Marcus

logs.message: ntp: no reply from time server (udp/123) host=api-node-3
jwt validation failed: token used before issued (iat is 121s ahead of local clock) host=api-node-3
jwt validation failed: token used before issued (iat is 124s ahead of local clock) host=api-node-3

ground_truth.root_cause: Clock drift on api-node-3. The egress restriction deployed in b77e310 blocks NTP (udp/123), so that node's clock fell about 2 minutes behind and it rejects freshly issued JWTs as used before issued. Allow NTP egress, resync the clock, and consider a small iat leeway.
